summary: Global Mofy AI Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the approval of a reverse stock split at a 50-for-1 ratio, effective June 11, 2026. The split was approved at the January 5, 2026 AGM and authorized by the board on May 26, 2026. No fractional shares are issued; rounding up applies. The reduction converts ~89.58M Class A and ~8.17M Class B shares to ~1.79M and ~0.16M shares, respectively, with par value adjusted to $0.0015. No special-situation event like an acquisition or restructuring is present; this is a routine share consolidation to meet Nasdaq listing requirements. No additional terms or advisors are mentioned.
